shots.prompt: A neutral scripted French product demonstration presenter in the exact real bathroom shown in the reference. Preserve the same adult stock model, tied-back hair, pale blue piped pajamas and honest skin texture. Static camera, calm conversation, natural subtle expressions and precise audio-driven lip synchronization. The bathroom mirror must show a physically consistent reflection of the same motion. No claims of personal experience, no product endorsement, no customer testimonial, no face replacement, no new packaging, no extra fingers, no text or logos. Benchmark only until the casting and reflection have been reviewed.
